title: Zapdos Has a Bizarre Entrance Rule
premise: Zapdos controls electricity and causes storms, yet its appearance has one unusually precise condition.
audiencePromise: Follow Zapdos from storm-maker to a legendary bird with the strangest arrival rule in its Pokédex entries.
openLoop: If Zapdos lives in thunderclouds and causes storms, why require a split?
payoff: Zapdos causes storms, yet appears only after one exact sky change.
engagementQuestion: Better entrance: arriving with lightning, or splitting a thundercloud?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and slightly dramatic. Pause briefly before each reveal, then land the final choice clearly.
